summary: [Square Inventory] objects: Square: InventoryChange (PHYSICAL_COUNT, ADJUSTMENT, TRANSFER; quantity, location, occurred_at, source application), InventoryCount (current calculated count per catalog object per location), CatalogObject (ITEM, ITEM_VARIATION, CATEGORY, TAX...), InventoryAdjustmentGroup, custom adjustment reasons. Counts are DERIVED from the change ledger: the ledger is the source of truth.
